sn47.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn47.13:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Sāriputto Magadhesu viharati Nālagāmake || ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ||
sn47.13:1.3: Cundo ca samaṇuddeso āyasmato Sāriputtassa upaṭṭhāko hoti || || 3.
sn47.13:2.1: Atha āyasmā Sāriputto tena ābādhena parinibbāyi || || 4.
sn47.13:2.2: Atha kho Cundo samaṇuddeso āyasmato Sāriputtassa pattacīvaram adāya yena Sāvatthi-Jetavanam Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Cundo samaṇuddeso āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn47.13:3.1: Atthi kho idam āvuso Cunda kathāpābhatam Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya ||
sn47.13:3.2: āyāmāvuso Cunda yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamissāma || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato etam attham ārocessāmāti || ||
sn47.13:3.3: Evam bhante ti kho Cundo samaṇuddeso āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosi || || 6.
sn47.13:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Ānando Cundo ca samaṇuddeso yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nīsīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn47.13:4.2: Ayam bhante Cundo samaṇuddeso evam āha ||
sn47.13:4.5: Api ca me bhante madhurakajāto viya kāyo || disā pi me na pakkhāyanti dhammā pi me na paṭibhanti āyasmā Sāriputto parinibbuto ti sutvā
sn47.13:5.1: ti || || 7. Kinnu te Ānanda Sāriputto sīlakkhandhaṃ vā ādāya parinibbuto || samādhikkhandhaṃ vā ādāya parinibbuto || paññakkhandhaṃ vā ādāya parinibbuto || vimuttikkhandhaṃ vā ādāya parinibbuto || vimuttiññanadassanakkhandhaṃ vā ādāya parinibbuto ti || ||
sn47.13:5.2: Na ca kho me tam bhante āyasmā Sāriputto sīlakkhandhaṃ vā ādāya parinibbuto || pe ||
sn47.13:5.6: Api ca me bhante āyasmā Sāriputto ovādako ahosi otiṇṇo viññāpako sandassako samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako akilāsu dhammadesanāya anuggāhako sabrahmacārīnaṃ
sn47.13:5.7: tam mayam āyasmato Sāriputtassa dhammojaṃ dhammabhogaṃ dhammānuggaham anussarāmāti || || 8.
sn47.13:6.1: Nanu tam Ānanda mayā paṭigacceva akkhātaṃ
sn47.13:6.2: sabbehi piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo ||
sn47.13:6.3: tam kutettha Ānanda labbhā || Yan taṃ jātam bhūtaṃ saṅkhatam palokadhammaṃ taṃ vata mā palujjīti
sn47.13:6.5: Seyyathāpi Ānanda mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato yo mahantataro khandho so palujjeyya ||
sn47.13:6.6: evam eva kho Ānanda mahato bhikkhusaṅghassa tiṭṭhato sāravato Sāriputto parinibbuto
sn47.13:6.7: taṃ kutettha Ānanda labbhā yan taṃ jātam bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ taṃ vata mā palujjīti
sn47.13:6.9: Tasmā ti hānanda attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā || ||
sn47.13:7.1: Kathañcānanda bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo || || 11.
sn47.13:7.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.13:7.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.13:7.6: Evaṃ kho Ānanda bhikkhu attadīpo viharati attasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo dhammadīpo dhammasaraṇo anaññasaraṇo || || 12.
sn47.13:7.7: Ye hi keci Ānanda etarahi vā mamaccaye vā attadipā viharissanti attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā || tamatagge pete Ānanda bhikkhū bhavissanti ye keci sikkhākāmā
